confirm.guarded: This is a guarded, audited action. Type {phrase} to confirm.

source.reason: Source dataset unavailable — it was demoted to Personal, archived, or deleted. Restore or re-promote it, or point this at a live dataset.

password.minLength: Use at least {min, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
password.mixClasses: Mix upper, lower, numbers and symbols (3 of 4)

chooseContext.alreadyAvailable: {count, plural, one {# already available to this app} other {# already available to this app}}

lifecycle.deleteHint: Delete permanently — removes the backing resource

confirm.archiveBody: It'll be hidden from lists but you can restore it anytime.

deleteBody.dataset: This permanently deletes dataset “{name}” and drops its Iceberg tables.
deleteBody.file: This permanently deletes file “{name}” and deletes the stored file.
deleteBody.app: This permanently deletes app “{name}” and tears down the running app and its repo.
deleteBody.agent: This permanently deletes agent “{name}” and removes its repo and schedule.
deleteBody.dashboard: This permanently deletes dashboard “{name}” and deletes the native dashboard spec.
deleteBody.metric: This permanently deletes metric “{name}” and removes it from the semantic layer.
deleteBody.connection: This permanently deletes connection “{name}” and purges its stored credential.
deleteBody.knowledge: This permanently deletes knowledge item “{name}” and removes it from the search index.

confirm.sharedTypeName: Others rely on this shared artifact — type its name to confirm.
confirm.archiveFolderBody: Archiving “{name}” also archives the {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} inside it. Move items out first if you want to keep them active. You can restore the folder later.
confirm.deleteFolderBody: This permanently deletes the folder “{name}” and {count, plural, one {the # item} other {all # items}} inside it.
confirm.restoreVersionBody: This makes version {version} the current state of “{name}”. Your current state is snapshotted first, so this is reversible.

versions.unavailable: No version history for this item.
versions.empty: No versions yet — the first change will start the history.

promote.certifyBody: Certifying makes this {kind} available across every domain, company-wide. This is a governed step that a platform admin vouches for.
promote.requestFiled: Request filed — approve this {kind} in Policies & Approvals.

demote.revokeBody: This lowers the {kind} from Company back to Domain — it stops being available across every domain. It is not deleted; you can promote it again later.
demote.unshareBody: This lowers the {kind} from Domain back to My — it stops being visible to your domain. It is not deleted; you can promote it again later.

goLive.retireBody: Run stops serving {kind} “{name}”. Nothing is deleted — the draft, its history and every version stay exactly as they are, and you can go live again at any time.

badgeTitle.draft: Being built. Not running — go live to make a version the one the OS runs.
badgeTitle.testing: A draft being tried out right now from Studio.
badgeTitle.live: The OS runs this version. Editing it does not change what Run shows.

lifecycle.badgeEdits: Your draft has moved on from {ref}.

folders.emptyHint: This folder is empty — there is nothing in it to grant yet.

badgeTitle.my: Yours. Promote it to Domain when colleagues should use it as an official artefact.
badgeTitle.domain: Shared with your domain as an official artefact.

approvalNotice.filed: Request filed — this {kind, select, other {{kind}}} is awaiting approval to {where, select, Company {Company} other {Domain}}. Approve it in Policies & Approvals.
